items.feature: Usage, analytics, cost and telemetry APIs; observability wiring
items.what_it_does: Use the existing aggregate JSON APIs through an opt-in local metrics adapter. Native Prometheus export is absent: both /metrics and /api/metrics returned JSON 404. GET /api/cache and /api/settings/cache-metrics expose aggregate provider-cache accounting; /api/usage/cache-health exposes cache-read/write distributions; /api/telemetry/summary exposes bounded runtime timing/session summaries. GET /api/usage/requests-by-provider-date exposes provider/day request and token totals without account identifiers. GET /v1/search/analytics exposes search counts, cache activity and estimated cost. Two responses need projection before export: /api/analytics/compression can contain compression-combo IDs, and /api/usage/analytics includes account/API-key breakdowns alongside its numeric summary. Scrape explicit numeric fields; never ingest complete responses as logs.
items.defaults: Telemetry defaults to windowMs=300000 and retains at most 1000 process-local observations. Cache-health defaults to range=24h, summarizes the newest 5000 qualifying call_logs rows, requires status=200, excludes rows with both cache counters NULL, and reports truncated. Compression defaults to since=24h; totalRequests counts saving runs, while totalSkipped counts skipped runs. Usage analytics defaults to range=30d. Cache trend defaults to 24 hours, clamped to 1–720; promptCache totals span retained usage_history, independently of trendHours. Detailed-payload logging defaults false when no legacy setting exists; ENABLE_REQUEST_LOGS can override the stored setting. These APIs require no new inference feature toggle.
items.controls: Select GET query scopes explicitly: /api/telemetry/summary?windowMs=300000; /api/cache?trendHours=24; /api/usage/cache-health?range=24h, optionally model; /api/analytics/compression?since=24h; /api/usage/analytics?range=1d; /v1/search/analytics. Management-auth checks remain subject to the existing login-off policy; verified loopback GETs required no credentials. Collector adoption is controlled by a separate prometheus/omniroute receiver and metrics/omniroute pipeline. The existing http_check/ecosystem receiver checks HTTP availability; adding JSON URLs there does not extract their usage counters. Preserve its /api/health target and use a JSON-to-Prometheus adapter for application metrics.

items.applies_to: CX and FW for recorded chat/Responses usage; SEARCH through its separate analytics endpoint. The local alpha-search adapter delegates to the shared search handler, whose records use /v1/search. Current aggregate APIs do not reliably distinguish CX from FW when they share provider/model accounts. Per-lane adoption therefore needs isolated measurement windows or independently recorded lane cohorts; do not infer lane identity from account identifiers or inject identifiers into prompts.
items.quality_risk: The proposed observer does not alter inference payloads, model selection or reasoning effort. Its unresolved risk is operational: synchronous database aggregation shares the gateway event loop, so sustained polling needs a load comparison. Privacy requires projection before telemetry storage: call-log rows expose account labels with email/connection-ID fallbacks; usage analytics includes byAccount/byApiKey; compression includes byCompressionCombo. The proposed adapter exports only fixed numeric paths and static labels. Upstream json_exporter logs response data on JSONPath errors, so the proposed service explicitly discards stdout/stderr and enables missing-key handling. Telemetry errorRate measures quota-monitor errors divided by the sampled request count; it is not an HTTP failure rate. Its timings also do not establish complete streamed-response latency.
items.cache_effect: No direct prompt-cache effect; retain the existing sticky account/session behavior. Keep provider prompt caching, semantic response caching and compression savings separate. requestsWithCacheControl counts reads OR writes, so its ratio is cache activity, not a strict read-hit rate. promptCache.totalInputTokens includes only cache-active requests; dividing cached tokens by that field overstates the all-request cached-token share. For that share, sum cachedTokens and inputTokens from the same cache.trend response. Zero reported Codex cache writes and a healthy cache-health verdict do not independently prove prefix stability.
items.token_effect: GET observation and numeric export require no model tokens and produce no token savings themselves. Against the supplied ~94% cached-input and ~1.2% output split, preserving cache continuity is the useful measurement priority. Cache tokensSaved means reused input tokens, not removed tokens; estimatedCostSaved uses a fixed $3/M input price and 90% discount. Usage totalCost is computed from pricing; codex/cx are explicitly excluded from flat-rate zeroing, so OAuth subscription traffic can show a positive API-equivalent estimate. Search cost is registry price multiplied by logged request counts. None is an invoice.
items.upstream_status: Verified through GitHub API fetch-and-index on 2026-09-27: cache-health PR #8827 merged on 2026-07-28. Prometheus/OTel bootstrap PR #4974 and Prometheus alert/SLO PR #5018 are closed and unmerged. Pinned monitoring docs describe native export as planned for v3.9. Their adjacent claim that latency has no REST endpoint is stale: the pinned implementation and live GET confirm /api/telemetry/summary exists. The /metrics rewrite intentionally falls through to the JSON catch-all; it is not a metrics implementation.
items.proposed_config:
Proposal only; nothing installed, edited or restarted. Existing aggregate GET APIs are reachable now. Adopt the observer after the lane/load/privacy experiment; gateway and client configuration delta is empty.
Use prometheus-community/json_exporter v0.8.0 with --web.listen-address=127.0.0.1:17979 --config.file=omniroute-json-exporter.yaml --log.level=error. Its systemd [Service] must set StandardOutput=null and StandardError=null because upstream extraction errors can log response data. Configure no body, credentials, dynamic labels or log forwarding. Export all 37 application series as gauges: rolling windows and retained-table totals can decrease. Do not apply increase() or sum consecutive snapshots. Alert on a missing per-module request gauge for 15 minutes; expose cache-health truncation. This adds six GETs per five minutes and exports through the existing loopback Prometheus exporter on port 18889.
items.experiment_needed: Completed: pin comparisons for the principal source files; live GET/status checks; all 37 proposed numeric paths resolved; the final receiver/pipeline overlay passed installed otelcol-contrib 0.161.0 validate against the repository config, with a validation-only existing-directory override for file_storage. Before adoption: run json_exporter --config.check and end-to-end /probe→Collector→Prometheus verification; exercise missing/invalid fields and verify no response bodies or identifiers reach metrics, journals or Loki. Compare polling off/on in matched CX, FW and SEARCH windows, holding models, effort and affinity constant. Require unchanged inference request bytes, no task-quality regression, and no material latency/error/cache regression. Reconcile counts with native client receipts using matching windows and truncation flags.
items.overturn_condition: Promote to ON-GLOBAL only after adapter privacy/error-path checks and polling-load comparisons pass for every active lane. Suspend collection if identity/body data escapes, polling materially worsens gateway latency/errors, or accounting cannot be reconciled. Replace the adapter only when a later pinned gateway actually implements and verifies an aggregate Prometheus endpoint; a rewrite, documentation roadmap or closed PR is insufficient.

citations.claim: GET /api/cache returns semantic-cache, prompt-cache, trend and idempotency aggregates; trendHours defaults to 24 and is clamped.

Totals use retained usage_history; input-token totals are restricted to cache-active rows; cache activity includes reads or writes; savings estimate uses $3/M and 90%; trend includes all input tokens.
/api/settings/cache-metrics exposes the same aggregate prompt-cache accounting behind management authentication.
Semantic hits, misses, entry counts and saved tokens are separate from provider prompt-cache metrics.
Warm/cold/rewrite classification, verdict thresholds, distributions, 5000-row cap, success filtering and truncation semantics.
Telemetry is process-local, capped at 1000 observations, and filtered to a default five-minute window.
Telemetry returns session counts and quota status counts instead of session/account identifiers.
activeConnections counts sessions; errorRate uses quota-monitor errors; uptime and process-memory values are added.
Telemetry is recorded when the handler returns its response; it does not establish complete streamed-response latency.
GET supports since=24h|7d|30d|all and defaults to 24h.
Saving runs and skips are separate; realUsage covers attached receipts; byCompressionCombo exposes stored combo IDs.
The response includes summary plus byAccount/byApiKey; no summary-only response is selected by the proposed range query.
Cost is computed from token/pricing data, flat-rate handling is conditional, and the default range is 30d.
codex/cx are deliberately excluded from flat-rate zero-cost classification.
Provider/day rows contain date, provider, request counts and token totals without account identifiers.
Account labels can fall back to email or connection ID, and rows explicitly contain connectionId.
ENABLE_REQUEST_LOGS takes precedence over call_log_pipeline_enabled; a stored zero alone does not prove the effective environment setting.
The setting inherits the legacy value or defaults to false.
Search analytics returns aggregate counts/cache activity and registry-based estimated cost.
The free-provider handler records search calls under /v1/search with requestType=search.
Local-only adapter delegates its queries to the shared search handler; this file is not cited as part of the upstream pin.
/metrics is rewritten for JSON 404 handling, with any future real metrics route taking precedence.
Native Prometheus/OTel export is documented as planned; the adjacent no-latency-REST statement conflicts with implemented behavior.
GitHub API confirmed #8827 merged; #4974 and #5018 closed without merge.
Gateway observation currently uses /api/health; the repository uses otelcol-contrib 0.161.0 and already exports Prometheus metrics on loopback.
Recorded snapshot values; cache-trend totals were calculated in context-mode without printing identity-bearing rows.

citations.ref: Live HTTP GET observations, 2026-09-27T16:18:11Z; numeric-path verification, 2026-09-27T16:25:00Z
citations.claim: Aggregate endpoints returned 200, native metrics paths returned 404, newer counters differed from the snapshot, and all 37 selected numeric fields resolved. No mutation methods were invoked.
Upstream adapter supports JSONPath projections, gauges and missing-key handling; no configured body means GET; booleans become 0/1; JSONPath errors can log response data.
Prometheus receiver consumes the adapter's metrics; HTTP check provides synthetic HTTP metrics rather than arbitrary JSON usage-field extraction.
Repository evidence records duplicate-looking call-log listings and a missing call-log record relative to native client usage; these observations limit accounting completeness claims.

unverified: The adapter is not installed or running. Native json_exporter configuration checks, actual Prometheus ingestion and failure-path privacy tests remain outstanding; Collector schema validation is not end-to-end acceptance.

Collector validation used an in-memory override pointing file_storage to an existing directory because the substituted validation data directory lacked collector/queue; no service configuration or filesystem contents were changed.
Effective ENABLE_REQUEST_LOGS was deliberately not inspected. Snapshot call_log_pipeline_enabled=0 does not rule out an environment override.
Polling overhead, per-lane attribution, complete request/stream accounting, and reconciliation against client receipts have not been measured for this observer.
Actual OAuth subscription charges and GPT-6 pricing accuracy are not established by gateway cost estimates.
Later GitHub API follow-ups for #4268 and #14618 returned HTTP 403; their detailed current state was not verified.
